evals.prompt: /gcpd implement cursor pagination and deploy each verified outcome using AGENTS.md's staging configuration.
evals.expected_output: Reads the installed git-commit skill completely and runs it in mode deploy with the rest of the request as the task.
assertions: The installed git-commit skill is read completely, including references/checkpoints.md and references/deploy.md, before any Git command or deployment.
The documented target and route are resolved before the first checkpoint is pushed.

evals.prompt: $gcpd on this refactor. The git-commit skill is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: Stops before any Git command and reports that git-commit must also be installed.
assertions: No Git repository is inspected or changed once git-commit is found to be missing.
The report names git-commit as the missing dependency.
The workflow is not rebuilt from memory and no other alias is used instead.

evals.prompt: 의미 있는 단위마다 커밋 푸시 배포해줘.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a natural-language request rather than the alias selector and uses git-commit directly in the mode the words select.
assertions: The selector-only gcpd alias is not chosen from phrasing alone.
git-commit states the resolved mode before its first Git command.

evals.prompt: $gcpd the first push succeeded and the deployment is still queued. Can this checkpoint be reported complete now?
evals.expected_output: Keeps the deploy confirmation gate: a queued deployment is INCONCLUSIVE, so the checkpoint is not complete and the next one waits.
assertions: Push success alone does not complete the checkpoint.
The next checkpoint waits for deployment success and the required checks.
